## Summary

What actual behavior changed? Which design/learning outcome does it support?

## Verification

- [ ] Python tests passed
- [ ] JavaScript syntax and shell syntax passed
- [ ] No private data or generated `.deb` files committed
- [ ] No automatic privileged OS changes or network requirements added
- [ ] Manual browser checks described (if UI changed)
- [ ] Real Pi hardware verified **or explicitly marked unverified**

## Privacy and recovery

How are the children's data, Linux permissions, local backups, and existing worlds preserved? How can an adult roll back this change?
